title: Ashbury Rewards Console Reference: Award Redeposits after Cancellation or No-Show
content:
Points deducted for a Reward Night Rate reservation come back after a cancellation or a no-show as one award redeposit transaction naming the redemption they return, posted on the member's Ashbury Rewards account.

## Conditions of the result

- Points come back as a redeposit naming the redemption they return, and the points returned against a redemption never exceed the points it deducted.

## Capability

`return_award_cancellation_points_76b4b6d2` returns points to an Ashbury Rewards account from the redemption of a cancelled or no-show Reward Night Rate reservation. One call records one redeposit transaction of source `award_redeposit` that names the award reservation and the redemption the points come back from, dated today, and adds the points to the points balance of the membership. The member sees the returned points in their account activity and in their balance straight away.

## Invocation

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, giving the name `return_award_cancellation_points_76b4b6d2`, and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loyalty_member_id` | Reference number of the Ashbury Rewards membership credited, as returned by the membership lookup for the verified member | Identifier |
| `reservation_id` | Reference number of the award reservation the points were redeemed for, as returned by the reservation lookup | Identifier |
| `related_transaction_id` | Reference number of the award redemption transaction the points are returned from, as returned by the account activity lookup | Identifier |
| `points` | Points returned | Whole number of points, always positive; integer, no decimals, no thousands separators |

The tool takes no source parameter: it always records the source `award_redeposit`.

## Return

A dictionary string with `transaction_id` (reference number of the redeposit transaction created), `loyalty_member_id` (membership credited), `reservation_id` (award reservation named), `related_transaction_id` (redemption named), `points` (integer points returned), `posted_date` (posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `points_balance` (points balance once the points are added). A returned `transaction_id` means the points are back on the account.

## Input and return (hypothetical values)

Returning 40000 `points` against a redemption, on an account holding 9500 points, returns `points` 40000 and `points_balance` 49500.
